computation_method.aggregate: weighted_adj=sum(adjusted_edge_jaccard*weight)/sum(weight); divJ=sum(TP)/(sum(TP)+sum(FP)+sum(FN)); proxy=weighted_adj+0.1*divJ; 24 sweep rows recomputed within1e-12
computation_method.leave_one_out: Only existing8 scored configurations; remove one FOV from each; choose highest if delta>=.001 and adj loss<=.0005. No hypothetical combo run or score inferred.
computation_method.runtime: Python3 standard library; no model imports/weights/graphs/inference.
